models.cacheTtlNotes: Two cache TTL tiers: 5 minutes by default and a 1-hour extended tier. Writes bill at 1.25x base input for the 5-minute tier and 2x for the 1-hour tier; reads bill at 0.05x on Opus 5.5. An entry's lifetime is measured from the start of the request, and changing output_config.effort invalidates the cached blocks.

models.windowNotes: Peak windows apply Monday-Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; every other hour is off-peak, including all of every weekend and holiday.
models.cacheTtlNotes: Context caching on disk is enabled by default and carries no separate write premium. An unused cache is cleared automatically, usually within a few hours to a few days.
models.notes: No cache-write price is published, so cacheWrite5m and cacheWrite1h are null. The legacy name deepseek-v4-flash is retired and is billed at V4.1-Flash prices on the DeepSeek API; the Ollama deepseek-v4-flash entry keeps its own Ollama prices.
